headline: Nvidia RTX Pro 4500 Blackwell delivers enterprise GPU efficiency gains
body: Nvidia released the RTX Pro 4500 Blackwell Server, achieving L40S-level throughput while consuming only 165W in a single slot form factor. For healthcare AI deployments, this density and power efficiency directly reduces infrastructure costs for on-premise inference workloads, critical for institutions running clinical decision support models, imaging analytics, or EHR-integrated AI features. The single-slot design simplifies data center architecture and cooling requirements, making it viable for smaller health systems and mid-market providers evaluating edge-based AI processing. Consultants advising on healthcare AI infrastructure should model this against current GPU procurement strategies, particularly for organizations balancing latency requirements against total cost of ownership.
